verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' public API documents issuing virtual cards (VCN) with a limit value, including CUSTOM uses. An Update VCN call tops up the ceiling, changes the validity window and adjusts controls without replacing the card. Corporate cards can be listed, blocked and unblocked, so all three elements of the story (create with limit, lock, update controls) are documented, though they are split across card types. Missing for 10: API issuance of corporate (non-VCN) cards, documented lock/unlock for VCNs (only cancel is shown), a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
